page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9a.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically powered by AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The absence of local NVMe drives and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance away from high-speed local storage operations or parallelized graphics processing workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU makes this instance profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive compute scaling. Appropriate workloads include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and structured data processing tasks where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck rather than raw CPU throughput or local disk I/O.
